name: Brenda O'Connor
household: Solo living, frequent visits from parents
psychographics: Values flexibility and saving money; constantly juggles multiple part-time remote jobs to make ends meet in a high-cost rural area.
current_solutions: Relies on a mobile 4G hotspot for work; uses the local library's computers to print payslips; shops at the discount supermarket in the nearest town once a month.
frustration: Was late submitting a client report at 11:30 AM because the 4G signal dropped for 20 minutes right as she was uploading the final PDF, causing the system to flag her as 'inactive'.
decision_style: Checks discount flyers on Facebook before buying anything; often chooses the cheaper option even if it means traveling further.
voice: Fast-paced and apologetic; uses lots of Irish slang like "grand" and "sure look" and frequently self-corrects mid-sentence.
